seedance_create_task.selection: Pass an exact configured ID as `model`, or omit it for the default. models.name: Seed TTS 3.0
models.availability: HTTP with operator-enabled TOS output storage and live Seed Speech/client-secret headers; local stdio with BYTEPLUS_SEED_SPEECH_API_KEY.
models.capabilities: Text or SSML, up to 10,000 characters; voice delivery and pronunciation controls; optional word alignment; MP3, PCM or Ogg Opus; up to 10 MiB collected audio. HTTP returns an expiring HTTPS download; stdio persists locally. Not live MCP audio.

seed_audio_generate.selection: This tool has no per-call `model` argument. The Seed Speech adapter uses the fixed model below; this is not a ModelArk model binding.

models.name: Seed Audio 1.0
models.availability: Local `BYTEPLUS_SEED_SPEECH_API_KEY`; HTTP invocation uses `X-Seed-Speech-Api-Key` plus client secret.
models.capabilities: Full-scene speech, music and sound generation; text, audio references or image reference; image and audio references are mutually exclusive; 1-5 independent variations.
